evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Reliable tissue detection is essential for whole-slide image analysis, yet high average segmentation accuracy can conceal failures involving pale tissue, small fragments, and heterogeneous staining.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Source-held-out experiments demonstrate better generalization than a segmentation network trained on the same annotations, while selective inference achieves an observed failure rate no higher than processing all candidate regions.
